purpose: Declare the public TypeScript process, terminal, configuration and error contracts.
behavior: run overloads infer string output by default and Uint8Array for text:false; spawn additionally chooses PipeChild or PtyChild from pty.
Common options include inherited/removed environment, timeout, RSS cap, cancellation, grace, byte/text mode, stderr merge and Windows verbatim arguments.
Child exposes single-consumer output/lines, dropped-byte accounting, write/wait/stop/processes and async disposal; only pipe children close stdin and only PTY children resize.
Exit reasons include memory_exceeded; OmniError has eight codes and optional collected RunResult.
contracts: Documents synchronous spawn startup failures versus Promise-returning run; nonzero process exits resolve unsuccessfully.
configure must precede the first run/spawn; backpressure is pipe-only and applies only while a consumer is attached.
dependencies: native/omni/docs/api-contract.md is the declared contract source.
failures_or_limits: Declarations do not validate runtime input; text and pty values only known at runtime produce unions.

purpose: Adapt JavaScript idioms and load the Rust addon without implementing process supervision.
behavior: Addon precedence is configure.addon, JS HUGR_OMNI_ADDON, installed platform package, then checkout debug/release only when no explicit configuration path was given; Linux libc is detected from ldd, then process.report, with glibc fallback.
configure eagerly loads, rejects invalid path fields, addon replacement and calls after run/spawn; supervisor precedence is configure then JS environment then native lookup.
Snapshots JS process.env into env with inheritEnv:false, preserving override/removal and case-insensitive Windows key replacement; one WeakMap cancellation and one listener are shared per signal.
Async iteration claims once and detaches in finally; Child caches the exit promise, exposes kind-specific methods and disposes through stop.
contracts: spawn throws synchronously; run/write/stop wrap immediate conversion errors as rejections.
started is set before native spawn/run invocation, so a native startup failure still prevents later configure.
dependencies: Native addon setup, configure, Cancel, spawn and run exports.
failures_or_limits: Unsupported/missing addon/load errors are plain Error; no platform loading was exercised.

purpose: Expose native Child operations while preserving JS collection, output and environment lifetime rules.
behavior: Converts spawn arguments, chooses pipe or PTY creation and registers an Arc-backed child with the current JS environment.
Delegates write, close, wait, stop and process inventory to core futures; terminal resize applies core numeric validation.
GC transfers an Arc to a keeper that awaits root exit then checks inventory at most once a second until empty; wait/inventory errors release it too.
Single-consumer NativeStream returns batches up to 8192 items; a later batch error is deferred to the next next(), null ends the stream, and detach drops reader/error state.
contracts: JS wrapper exposes closeStdin only for pipes and resize only for terminals; native cross-kind calls are no-ops.
Pending operations and readers retain the child; repeated wait identity is supplied by index.js.
failures_or_limits: Keeper release on inventory error follows the documented lost-supervisor policy; no lifecycle execution observed.

purpose: Translate JavaScript arguments into core commands and core values into plain JS output objects.
behavior: Wrong types become field/value-specific INVALID_ARGUMENT; nullish optional fields are omitted, while getter exceptions propagate.
Copies string UTF-8 or Uint8Array input; reads environment entries with nullish removal, booleans, stdin choices, cancellation, verbatim arguments, time/byte limits and PTY sizes.
Delegates millisecond, byte-limit and PTY-side numeric rules to hugr_omni::binding; true/default PTY is 80×24 and false/nullish disables PTY.
Serializes nullable exit/process fields, text or Uint8Array data, six reason strings, stream labels and optional loss/continuation markers.
contracts: Conversion reads run and spawn option families alike; the core ignores options irrelevant to the invoked operation.
Signal without a supplied native Cancel is rejected unless nullish; env getter errors remain caller errors.
failures_or_limits: Counter conversion to f64 follows JS number representation; this file does not establish OS process behavior.

purpose: Preserve core errors as the correct per-environment JavaScript OmniError class.
behavior: setup starts the binding executor, registers the environment cleanup hook and stores a strong constructor reference plus Owned child registry.
Core errors retain code/message and cloned collected run result; malformed JS values get INVALID_ARGUMENT with field, shown value and correction.
Primitive display avoids running user conversion code, truncates strings at 80 Unicode scalar positions and names object/function/symbol/bigint kinds.
Environment finalization deliberately forgets the constructor reference because the dying engine frees it and deleting it can fail during Bun worker teardown.
contracts: configure delegates the process-wide supervisor path rule to the core binding.
If setup/constructor access fails, make returns that napi error instead of manufacturing OmniError.
failures_or_limits: The no-finalizer-panic rationale is source documentation, not a newly observed Bun result.

purpose: Poll core futures and settle JS promises without introducing another Tokio runtime.
behavior: Starts one process-global hugr-omni-node thread behind a mutex and OnceLock queue.
promise creates a JsDeferred, polls the job once on the calling JS thread to preserve invocation order, then resumes it on wakeups through the executor.
Timer storage is executor-thread-local and used by the GC keeper; queued tasks hold a mutex-protected future.
A Settle drop rejects an unfinished deferred; polling catches unwinds and drops completed or panicked jobs so promises do not hold the event loop indefinitely.
contracts: Core futures must be Send/static and runtime-independent; the JS thread may perform run's bounded spawn during the initial poll.
Task creation before setup drops the job, triggering settlement cleanup.
dependencies: native/omni/bindings/node/src/error.rs starts the executor and maps failures.
failures_or_limits: Queue/thread shutdown is intentionally absent; comments assume the global sender keeps the receiver alive.

purpose: Bridge native run to a JS promise containing the core's collected output.
behavior: Converts command, argument vector, options and optional cancellation using convert::command.
Awaits cmd.run() through exec::promise and converts successful RunOutput with convert::run_result.
contracts: Conversion can throw synchronously at the native boundary; index.js converts that throw to a rejected Promise.
failures_or_limits: Run completion semantics and output limits remain the core's responsibility.

purpose: Stop trees belonging to a terminating JS environment within one bounded cleanup wait.
behavior: Owned keeps Weak child references, pruning dead entries when adding a child.
stop_all drains and upgrades live children, schedules zero-grace stops on the binding executor and waits for completion signals until one shared five-second deadline.
Stop errors are ignored for cleanup completion; timeout or receiver error returns from the hook.
contracts: The ending JS thread waits but never calls back into JS; process operations run on the binding thread.
Collection of one Child still does not kill its tree; environment teardown is a separate lifetime boundary.
failures_or_limits: Returning at the bound does not prove every failed stop succeeded; final host-death supervision is separate.

purpose: Provide isolated subprocess cases for one-time addon/supervisor configuration and JS environment inheritance.
behavior: order loads the built addon with an intentionally missing supervisor, then attempts addon replacement, spawn, late configure and an invalid supervisor field.
no-fallback and env-addon select nonexistent explicit addons; env-run sets a late process.env value and compares inherited with inheritEnv:false output.
Collects each synchronous attempt as [operation, ok/code, message] and emits one final JSON line before exit.
contracts: Each scenario requires a fresh process because native loading/configuration is sticky.
hardening.mjs interprets outcomes; this host records observations rather than asserting them.
failures_or_limits: Only the debug checkout addon path is constructed here; unknown case throws.

purpose: Run the shared conformance scenario corpus through the public TypeScript binding.
behavior: Checks the cross-language regex table before any scenarios; mismatch immediately returns a failed summary.
Warms the fixture executable, then invokes suite with scenarios, pending ledger, fixture path and loaded public API.
Reports passed/pending/failed plus OS/runtime and selection counts; only failures make the returned exit code one.
contracts: Requires fixture and supervisor binaries built first.
Pending product failures are allowed only through the ledger; skipped is not a result category.
failures_or_limits: Source describes execution policy; no conformance scenarios were executed in this analysis.

purpose: Assert WP-H worker, configuration, environment and output-hardening behavior across JS hosts.
behavior: Worker cases require normal host exit, no panic/abort diagnostics and both live-tree PIDs already dead when terminate resolves.
Fresh-host cases assert explicit paths outrank environment, missing paths do not fall back, late/invalid configure rejects, and JS process.env updates propagate or are removed.
Checks Windows PATH case folding and override spelling.
Floods 64 MiB with a stalled consumer: backpressure must deliver every byte exactly with no loss; default mode must account for received plus lost bytes and match droppedBytes.
contracts: Runs through mini.mjs with a 60-second per-test deadline; subprocesses default to 30 seconds.
The default-mode test does not require loss to occur, only correct accounting if it does.
dependencies: Native fixture and the public index.js API.
failures_or_limits: Runtime/OS assertions were read, not executed.

purpose: Create controlled host-lifecycle states for idiom tests without installing product cleanup hooks.
behavior: Starts fixture trees and prints HOST markers only after required PIDs/readiness are known.
end releases the root by a watched file; exit/throw wait for a parent stdin line; wait remains alive until signaled.
retain starts a child without awaiting; gc drops all references then forces ten collections; orphan does the same after root exit while a descendant survives.
contracts: Uses Bun.gc or exposed global gc and fails if unavailable.
The parent process decides when to terminate or release the host; modes emit evidence rather than assertions.
failures_or_limits: Marker existence alone does not prove later cleanup; idioms.mjs checks liveness independently.

purpose: Manage lifecycle-test host subprocesses and expose bounded marker/exit observations.
behavior: Launches host.mjs under the current runtime with a temporary release file and captured output/error streams.
marker validates complete HOST marker PID sets and rejects a host that exits before the marker; end waits for close with a diagnostic bound.
go writes a synchronized input line, kill forwards the requested signal, and getters expose termination timing.
finally kills the host, removes the temporary directory and, on a failed test only, force-kills every reported PID; a parent exit hook also kills live host subprocesses.
contracts: Marker waits default to 15 seconds and host-end waits to 10 seconds; timeout rejects, never silently skips.
failures_or_limits: Cleanup is test harness behavior and must not be confused with hooks in the production binding.

purpose: Assert TypeScript-specific API idioms and whole-host lifecycle guarantees.
behavior: Checks exact async chunk output, permanent consumer detachment, async disposal tree death, AbortSignal behavior, OmniError identity/messages and PipeChild/PtyChild method separation.
Exercises wrong JS option/value types and preserves the identity of a caller getter exception; strips comments before rejecting any in declarations.
For normal return, process.exit, uncaught exception, SIGINT, SIGTERM and SIGKILL, requires a live three-PID tree before host termination and dead tree within five seconds afterward.
Separately verifies a child holds the event loop and GC leaves both live roots and orphan descendants running until host death.
contracts: Uses fixture markers rather than delays for readiness; per-test deadline is 60 seconds.
POSIX signal exit identity is checked only off Windows.
dependencies: Native fixture plus the public binding.
failures_or_limits: The opening RED-until-W13 comment is historical; this source is not evidence of a current failure or pass.
